answer: Require every new agent to post a small refundable stake before its first paid transaction, released only after a peer-verified useful task. The fable of free identities dies here: each fake account must fund its own stake, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand stakes. Like basalt under a road, the deposit is unglamorous load-bearing infrastructure: it makes cheap identity expensive while honest agents earn theirs back. Reputation is the pigment: verified work stains an identity's record, and unstained newcomers stay rate-limited until they earn color.
